name: Brunel University London

facts.text: Brunel's single campus is in Uxbridge, west London.
Brunel was awarded its Royal Charter in 1966.

The university is organised into four colleges: Brunel Business School; the College of Arts, Law and Social Sciences; the College of Engineering, Design and Physical Sciences; and the College of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences.
With approximately 2,500 staff, Brunel is one of the largest employers in the Uxbridge area.
Brunel holds Athena SWAN accreditation for good employment practices for women in science, engineering and technology.

sources.title: Brunel University London – CAS Shield Interview Policy and Procedure (Version 1, June 2024; last updated September 2024)
topics: The reason why the applicant has chosen to study in the UK, and at Brunel University
The reason why the applicant has chosen their particular course
The applicant’s post-study plans and how their course may support them in this
The applicant’s financial circumstances and how they expect to fund their studies in the UK
The applicant’s arrangements for UK accommodation
The applicant’s awareness of the Student visa regulations
‘Random’ questions on unrelated topics may be included to prevent the use of scripted answers
sources.notes: Themes only, no verbatim questions in the policy. Format: 'Interviews are conducted via the online CAS Shield software in a recorded video format, where a series of questions are read out and displayed on a computer... the applicant must display their passport on the camera for an ID check. Each interview takes approximately 15-20 minutes to complete. The questions are randomised.' Assessed afterwards by Brunel Compliance/Admissions staff. Selection primarily by nationality (list given: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Iran, Afghanistan, Uzbekistan, Nigeria, Ghana – 'not an exhaustive list'); applies to UG, PGT and research applicants; Brunel Pathway College applicants excluded; exempt if already interviewed for academic selection. Outcomes: Pass / Resit (one resit only, whole or specific subject areas) / Reject-Fail. 'The interviews are not used as a method to assess the English proficiency of the applicant... However, a failure of an applicant to be able to answer the questions to a sufficient standard of English will likely lead to a rejection due to credibility concerns.' Automatic rejection for proxy interviewee, scripted/internet/AI material, or off-camera coaching. Appeals in writing to the Compliance and Sponsorship Manager within 7 days; a successful appeal only grants a resit. Rejected applicants may reapply for a future intake. The visa FAQ page (https://www.brunel.ac.uk/international/visas-and-immigration/Frequently-Asked-Questions) was fetched but only says 'This includes the completion of your CAS application (CAS Shield)' with no interview detail.
